annotations.title: Change a number’s settings or profile

description: Changes one WhatsApp number, named by id. action settings takes delivery_mode (stored or direct) and override_callback_url (where Meta’s webhooks for the number go; null clears it). action display_name takes display_name and submits it to Meta’s review; Meta’s decision shows on the number later. action profile takes any of about, description, address, email, websites, vertical and profile_picture (a media id from an upload on this number); every customer sees the profile. Each action changes things only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview naming the number and a token for a person to approve. The number’s webhook verify token and relay secret read as null here; they are in the number’s settings in the Cosend dashboard. Owners and admins.

action.description: settings changes how Meta’s messages for the number are handled. display_name submits a new name to Meta’s review. profile edits the business profile customers see.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

override_callback_url.description: Your endpoint for Meta’s webhooks for this number. On a `direct` number Cosend sets it as the number’s webhook override at Meta, and Meta sends the number’s messages, echoes, calls and history to it itself; Meta checks it first with `webhook.verify_token`, and keeps template and account webhooks on Cosend. On a `stored` number Cosend receives and keeps every change and relays each one to it in Meta’s envelope, signed `X-Cosend-Signature-256: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the body with webhook.relay_secret>`, retried with back-off until a 2xx. `null` clears it.

retention_months.description: Retention is one account-wide setting and is no longer configured per connection. Set it with PATCH /v1/account/data-policy.
